name: openwave-spec
description: OpenWave API standard for payments, Open Banking, Credit & Finance, NPT identity, webhooks, and gateway interconnect.

scripts.spec:lint: REDOCLY_TELEMETRY=off REDOCLY_SUPPRESS_UPDATE_NOTICE=true redocly lint openwave-payments-v1.yaml openwave-presented-payments-v1.yaml openwave-open-banking-v1.0.yaml openwave-credit-finance-v1.yaml openwave-identity-v1.0.yaml openwave-gateway-interconnect-v1.yaml
scripts.test: npm run public:check && npm run spec:lint && npm run spec:contract
scripts.docs:build: npm run public:check && vitepress build docs
